_comment: All paths are relative to the project root. Every parameter that the paper states explicitly is annotated with where it comes from.

counting._comment: uptag_offset 28 is the value hard-coded in the original BarSeq.py (the uptag begins at base 29). Confirm it for your FASTQs with step01 before relying on it. The fuzzy slide values reproduce the original 25-30 search window.

imputation._comment: Paper: genes with at least 20 normalized read counts in all three replicates of the starting pool but missing reads at 10 generations receive a pseudocount of 1 on the raw reads.

statistics._comment: Paper: edgeR with generation as a factor, BH FDR < 0.05.
statistics._backend_comment: Recommended backend for steps 05 and 10 is 'edgepython' (pip install edgepython), a pure-Python edgeR port. 'python' is the built-in no-dependency fallback; 'edger' calls real edgeR via rpy2. Pass --backend on the CLI.

gene_lists._comment: Paper: commonly deleterious = significant defect in at least 66% of 15 strains, i.e. 10. Strain-specific = significant in one strain and not more than two others.

reference_values._comment: Numbers reported in the paper, used by the pipeline to print sanity checks. Not used in any calculation.
